tools.name: openai_ads_get_insights
tools.title: openai ads get insights
tools.description: Read performance by account, campaign, ad group or ad over inclusive account-local dates. One optional country, device or platform breakdown supports delivery metrics only; use openai_ads_get_conversion_insights for conversions by country or device. Attribution defaults to 30-day click, 1-day view and ad_event_time. CTR and CVR are fractions; money uses major units of the account currency. Pages are followed up to maxRows and truncation is explicit.

adAccountId.description: The adacct_ ID configured in OPENAI_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID. The API key is scoped to this one account; another ID is refused.

since.description: First day of the report, YYYY-MM-DD, in the account's time zone. Inclusive.

until.description: Last day of the report, YYYY-MM-DD, in the account's time zone. Inclusive. At most 365 days after since.

level.description: Aggregation level: ad_account, campaign, ad_group or ad. Defaults to campaign.

metrics.description: Native metrics to return. Defaults to spend, impressions and clicks.

timeGranularity.description: daily returns one row per day; none returns period totals.

maxRows.description: Maximum rows to collect across pages, 1 to 10,000. truncated is true when more rows exist.

breakdown.description: One delivery breakdown per request: country, device or platform. Supports impressions, clicks, spend, ctr, cpc and cpm. Omit for entity totals.

attribution.description: Report attribution only: attribution_window_days 7, 14 or 30, view_through_attribution_window_days 0 or 1, attribution_time_basis ad_event_time or conversion_time. Campaign goals are unchanged.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: openai_ads_create_campaign
tools.title: openai ads create campaign
tools.description: Create a paused campaign with its objective, budget, schedule and targeting. Previews by default: call without confirm to receive a saved preview and confirmationToken, then repeat the identical call with confirm:true and that token once the person approves. Creations are always paused. Budgets and bids use integer account-currency micros. Nothing is retried automatically. See openai_ads_get_write_schema for nested fields.

adAccountId.description: The adacct_ ID configured in OPENAI_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID. The API key is scoped to this one account; another ID is refused.

body.description: Exact pinned native JSON request body. Nested configuration objects replace their previous contents, so send the complete intended configuration. Money uses integer account-currency micros.

requestId.description: A UUID you choose for this exact logical change. Keep it for the preview, the confirmation and any later reconciliation. Creations send it as the native Idempotency-Key.

confirm.description: false returns a saved preview and changes nothing. true applies only that exact preview after the person explicitly approved it.

confirmationToken.description: The confirmationToken returned by the preview of these exact arguments. Required with confirm:true.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.
